coordinate_system.instance_origin_meaning: shared stage placement; neither pelvis nor shoe pivot
coordinate_system.normalization_for_metadata_only: u=x/800, v=y/1000; use pixel coordinates for registration
coordinate_system.scale_policy: uniform transformation of complete registered construction; no independent limb stretching
coordinate_system.sides: anatomical L/R of musician; shoulder R is screen-left in this camera
coordinate_system.depth: explicit sprite order per pose; independent of X/Y

camera.view: audience, near-frontal, slightly elevated, matched to approved combined reference
camera.rule: one shared camera across musician, kit and skins; projected lengths are pose-specific

layout_seeds_from_v1.status: composition-guides-only; remeasure if the combined master changes
layout_seeds_from_v1.region_provenance: drummer-seated-v0 template; illustrative ellipses, not newly measured v2 surfaces

authoring_spaces.skin_and_arm_rest_landmarks: drawing-canvas at reference pose; transformed through torso at runtime
authoring_spaces.runtime_solver_target: convert fixed canvas target into torso-local space before solving

grip_policy.optional_stick_rotation: only within a drawn and reviewed finger/occlusion envelope
grip_policy.stick_length_reference: shared visual construction; projected lengths may differ with authored foreshortening

segmentation_policy.rule: split by motion or distinct depth relation; reconstruct hidden surfaces; no disc remnants in fixed hardware
segmentation_policy.z_policy: structural transform nodes z=0; unique sprite ranks per pose; actor root controls stage depth
segmentation_policy.rest_recomposition: compare separated composite to approved combined master

reuse.compatibility: validated family-plus-kit-plus-skin combination, not an unconditional shared skeleton
reuse.single_source_rule: derive runtime, export metadata and QA guides from canonical family/kit/skin data

proposed_acceptance.tolerance_status: initial review criterion, not yet validated against v2 artwork
proposed_acceptance.joint_limits: measure approved keyposes; do not invent anatomical ranges from projected coordinates
